scope: Selected primary sources; original summaries, no full-text import. Interpretive limits are protocol authors' inferences.

sources.title: Brain-wide mapping reveals that engrams for a single memory are distributed across multiple brain regions
sources.access: Publisher and indexed primary text/abstract and methods excerpts inspected; not systematic review
sources.supports: Distributed engram evidence in mouse fear-memory paradigm
sources.does_not_support: Complete human memory localization, historical memory decoding, source identity or 7D storage

sources.title: Invariant visual representation by single neurons in the human brain
sources.access: Indexed PubMed abstract inspected; full publisher retrieval blocked
sources.supports: Selective MTL neuron responses across pictures/names of individuals or concepts
sources.does_not_support: A neuron storing an entire person's identity, transferable memories or byte capacity

sources.title: Neural mechanisms of reactivation-induced updating that enhance and distort memory
sources.access: Primary full-text introduction, methods-context and findings inspected
sources.supports: Human memory reactivation associated with enhancement and distortion in controlled museum paradigm
sources.does_not_support: All subjective experiences are false or any particular participant's report is explained

sources.title: Semantic reconstruction of continuous language from non-invasive brain recordings
sources.access: Publisher abstract and extended-data/methods details inspected
sources.supports: Constrained semantic reconstruction from trained cooperative subjects' fMRI; poor cross-subject transfer in reported tests
sources.does_not_support: Unrestricted mind reading or reading historical tissue without a learned decoder

sources.title: The cerebral cortex of Albert Einstein: a description and preliminary analysis of unpublished photographs
sources.access: Primary bibliographic/abstract-index record inspected; PMC captcha and publisher full-text retrieval blocked. No complete paper appraisal claimed.
sources.does_not_support: Complete synaptic map, decoded memory content, memory capacity or reconstruction of Einstein's knowledge

sources.title: NIST SP 800-90A Revision 1
sources.supports: Reference for reviewed deterministic random-bit generation mechanisms
sources.does_not_support: Certification of the unimplemented target system
